cost: O(B + R log N + per-row sentence/answer comparisons), O(B+S) stored views.
description: Pure synthetic-input QA row and batch gates with local anchor/span validation and dense acceptance numbering.
forward: Batch classification then paragraph ordered folds of row predicates, deduplication and capacity.
inverse: Set-valued compatible row streams; ignored lines, normalization and row rejection lose input information.
limitations: Public span_reason assumes prevalidated aligned sentence views and anchors.

state: Batch errors imply no accepted rows; accepted local anchors sorted unique; at most six rows per paragraph.
